inputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Filesystem directory in which the repository creates or opens `provider-switches.sqlite`. It creates the directory recursively with mode 0700 and sets the database file mode to 0600.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.get.sessionId
inputs.description: Session key used to look up a row with an exact `session` match. It is not normalized or validated by this repository.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.put.record
inputs.description: Switch request serialized into the row's `data` column, with `record.sessionId` used as the session key and `switchRevision(record)` stored as the row id. The exact required fields of `SwitchRequest` are defined outside the two permitted implementation files.

examples.reason: Switch this session to the selected provider model.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.put.expectedId
inputs.description: Expected current `switches.id` value used in the conditional update when a row for the session already exists. A non-null value must equal the stored id for that update to change a row; null does not match an existing id.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.get
outputs.description: Stored switch request parsed from the matching row, or null when no row exists for the session. A failed query or malformed stored JSON throws.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.put
outputs.description: True when SQLite reports exactly one row changed by the insert or conditional update, and false otherwise. The method returns only this change result.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.list
outputs.description: Stored switch requests ordered by descending rowid, with at most 100 rows returned. Each row's data is parsed as JSON and malformed stored data throws.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchRepository.close
outputs.description: Closes the repository's SQLite database connection. It returns no value.

errors.name: Provider switch filesystem or SQLite failure
errors.description: A filesystem operation, SQLite loading, or SQLite operation failed. The repository does not catch or translate these failures.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse rejected malformed stored row data while get or list was reading it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: JSON.stringify rejected a record containing a cycle or a value such as BigInt while put was serializing it.
